Annual Report 2025

Revenue grew by 12% in the fiscal year. Operating costs stayed flat, and the board approved a new research budget for the next twelve months.

Operating costs

Facilities and travel were the largest categories. The finance team expects a modest increase in the coming year, driven by the new office.

Outlook

The company plans to invest in local-first software and offline tools. No cloud migration is planned for the current fiscal year.
